landing.title: All your investments, finally explained.
landing.subtitle: Bayan brings your Moroccan shares, foreign ETFs, gold and crypto into one portfolio, in one currency — and tells you in plain words what happened to them today.
landing.free: Free while in beta. No card needed.

preview.newsText: Half-year revenue up 12 %. No change to the announced dividend.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to follow your money, nothing more.

oneView.title: One portfolio, every market
oneView.text: Casablanca, US and European stocks, ETFs, gold and crypto, valued together in dirhams, euros or dollars.

explained.title: News you can understand
explained.text: Long announcements turned into two clear sentences, with a link to the original. Only for the assets you care about.

calendar.title: Never miss a dividend
calendar.text: Dividend dates, general meetings and results for your assets, with a reminder a few days before.

alerts.title: Alerts that matter
alerts.text: Be told when a price crosses your level or moves sharply in a day — and not the rest of the time.

landing.howTitle: Up and running in three steps

one.title: Create your account
one.text: Choose your language and the currency you think in.

two.title: Add what you own
two.text: Enter your purchases once. Bayan keeps prices, gains and dividends up to date.

three.title: Check in each evening
three.text: See your day at a glance and read only the news that concerns you.

inform.title: We inform. We never advise.
inform.text: Bayan explains what happened, with its sources. It never tells you to buy or sell — those decisions stay yours.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.text: Your portfolio is private to your account, protected at the database level. Export it or delete it whenever you want.

landing.finalTitle: Know where your money stands, in a minute a day.
